subject: c12-phy

weightage.label: Dual Nature + Atoms and Nuclei (Ch 11 to 13)

note: Marks are official and given per group of units (total 70). Question mix: remembering and understanding 27 marks (38%), applying 22 (32%), analysing, evaluating and creating 21 (30%). Practical is 30 marks.
mistakes: Numericals: write the formula, substitute with units, and state the unit in the answer. Unit and sign slips lose easy marks.
Ray optics: apply the sign convention consistently, measuring all distances from the pole or optical centre.
Alternating current: do not mix peak and rms values.
Draw neat, labelled diagrams, including arrows on rays, field lines and circuit symbols.
Learn each derivation as a short chain of steps, so you can rewrite it without memorising it word for word.
order: Chapters 1 to 3 (16 marks) first: electric field and circuits are the base for later chapters.
Chapters 4 to 7 (17 marks) next: AC builds on electromagnetic induction.
Chapters 8 to 10 (18 marks, the largest group): EM waves and optics.
Chapter 14 (7 marks) last, as it is the shortest.
Do practical and record file work alongside the theory.
